annotations.title: Email deliverability check: MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM and score

description: Email deliverability check for a domain in one call: MX records, SPF and its all-policy, DMARC and its policy, DKIM keys at the common selectors (Google, Microsoft, Mailchimp and others), MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, with a 0-100 score, a grade and a list of fixes; optionally also checks one address (syntax, MX, disposable domain). Uses public DNS only and sends no mail. Use before a campaign, when mail lands in spam, or to vet a sender domain. Example: domain=github.com. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

domain.description: The sending domain, such as example.com (or a URL; its host is used)

email.description: Optional address to check as well
